edges.note: Revised after the computed S1 attempts (scan_s1b monotonic +52 kcal/mol with no maximum; ts_0007 reached only a -116 cm^-1 allyl-CH2 torsion). In the chair the six-atom array is O4-C3-C2=C1...C6=C5: the bond that forms is the allyl TERMINAL CH2 (map C1) to the ortho carbon C6, while O4-C3 breaks and C3 becomes the terminal methylene; O4 becomes the dienone C=O. Per the task atom map the same elementary step reads as form [[3,6]] because unlabelled 2-allylphenol cannot distinguish the two CH2 termini; the two readings are the same single step, not two channels.
